statement.zh: 研究与教科文将三内丸山表述为日本北部大型绳文聚落，并纳入「北海道·北东北绳文遗址群」世界遗产（Habu；UNESCO 1632）。
statement.en: Research and UNESCO frame Sannai-Maruyama as a large northern Japanese Jōmon settlement within the Jōmon Prehistoric Sites serial property (Habu; UNESCO 1632).
